$comment: Labels the store-screenshots flow taps or waits for, per language (developer-home scripts/store-screenshots.mjs passes them with maestro -e). Words come from apps/mobile/src/i18n/messages/{common,start,play,history}.ts; L_TAB_BAR is the tab bar's accessibility name; L_BACK is the system back button; L_ALLOW is iOS's location prompt button; L_COURSE is the demo course the account's rounds are on.

en.L_OFF_HOLE: Not on this hole — distances from the tee
en.L_NO_GPS: No GPS — distances from the tee

nl.L_OFF_HOLE: Niet op deze hole — afstanden vanaf de tee
nl.L_NO_GPS: Geen GPS — afstanden vanaf de tee
